reason: I only hate hotel tap water a few times a year, so $68 up front plus a filter subscription is a lot for a problem I have maybe a dozen days a year. And the $12.99 shipping on the bottle alone feels like a penalty to push me into the plan.
objection: It's another subscription I'll forget to cancel, and the filters only last 2 months whether I use them or not, so I'd be paying for filters sitting in a drawer.
would_change_my_mind: Bottle alone around $35 with free shipping and filters I can buy one at a time when I need them, no subscription, or a bigger discount code than 5%.
